props.defaultText: Yellow box = the counting ROI, green circles = the blobs that are counted. Drag the box to move it, pull the handles to resize it, or drag on an empty part of the picture to draw a new one (the sliders follow). Press Threshold on the camera to see what counts as bright. Changes apply to the next test.
